intro: Warehouse {{warehouse}}: draw the warehouse like a spreadsheet. Each cell is a walkway, a wall, a shelf with containers or a special area. Saving creates shelves, storage locations, walls and pick points from it.

mode.label: Editor
mode.leaveBody: The grid has unsaved changes. They are lost when you switch to the advanced editor.
mode.managedHint: This warehouse has a grid. The next grid save puts shelves, walls and pick points from the grid back in place – better change them in the grid.

hint.Walkway: Empty cell: people can walk here. Painting with walkway clears cells.
hint.Wall: Wall: blocks the way, routes go around it.
hint.Door: Door or gate in a wall: walkable.
hint.Obstacle: Pillar, machine or other obstacle: blocks the way like a wall.
hint.Shelf: Shelf cell with X containers (storage locations) for normal stock.
hint.PackingStorage: Packing buffer: containers for picked goods before packing (not used by pick lists).
hint.OutgoingStorage: Outgoing storage: containers for packed goods before shipping (not used by pick lists).
hint.Returns: Returns area: containers for returned goods before inspection (not used by pick lists).
hint.Packing: Packing station: pick point that can be chosen as start or end.
hint.GoodsReceipt: Goods receipt: marked, walkable area for deliveries.

sheet.label: Warehouse grid with {{columns}} columns and {{rows}} rows

toolbar.label: Edit grid
toolbar.selectHint: Click cells or drag with the mouse; right-click or double-click chooses the cell type.
toolbar.overlay_one: Show {{count}} object from the advanced editor
toolbar.overlay_other: Show {{count}} objects from the advanced editor

save.done: Saved: {{created}} shelves added, {{removed}} removed, {{containersCreated}} containers added, {{containersRemoved}} removed, {{walls}} walls, {{pickPoints}} pick points.
save.discardBody_one: {{count}} changed cell is reset to the saved state.
save.discardBody_other: {{count}} changed cells are reset to the saved state.

panel.label: Selection
panel.help1: Paint: choose a cell type above and drag across the grid.
panel.help2: Select: mark cells with “Select”, then choose the type with a right-click, double-click or Enter.
panel.help3: Containers: the number above applies to new storage cells and to selected shelves.
panel.help4: Save creates shelves, storage locations, walls and pick points. Delete turns selected cells back into walkway, Ctrl+Z undoes.
panel.overlayHint_one: Dashed: {{count}} object from the advanced editor. It stays unchanged when saving.
panel.overlayHint_other: Dashed: {{count}} objects from the advanced editor. They stay unchanged when saving.
panel.blocked: Containers here have stock, open tasks or documents – they cannot be removed.

settings.title: Grid size and containers
settings.containerTooLarge: A container's width and depth must not exceed the cell size.
settings.dropped_one: {{count}} used cell lies outside the new size and will be removed.
settings.dropped_other: {{count}} used cells lie outside the new size and will be removed.
settings.note: The change only applies when you save and can be undone.
settings.applied: Grid is now {{columns}} × {{rows}} cells (not saved yet).
